actionType.description:
The type of the action. This identifies it so it can be consumed by
{@link Ann.UiSdlReducer} and {@link Ann.UiSdlEpic}.
NOTE: The real field name is `type` but it is reserved

payload.description:
The data to be sent as payload. Consumers of this action
can use this as parameters.

error.description: If true, it means this action contains error information

title: A {@link UiSdlReduxAction} for {@link UiSdlNavMenu} triggered when a user is no longer hovering over a nav menu item.
name: UiSdlNavMenuItemHoverOffAction
